visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) KID, a shirtless man with tan skin and ear piercings, stands outdoors holding a white clipboard and pen. He actively gestures while explaining divemaster exam requirements. Behind him is a weathered concrete wall and a parked motorcycle under bright natural sunlight. (2) The scene shifts to a visual montage of diving tasks in turquoise seawater. A diver wearing a black wetsuit and snorkeling gear is seen swimming freestyle, treading water with hands raised, and performing a rescue tow. Bubbles and ripples dominate the water surface. (3) KID, now wearing a black wetsuit, stands next to a bearded instructor in a black tank top. They look at the scoring sheet together, with KID showing expressions of anxiety and then explosive joy as his passing scores are revealed. Diving gear is visible. (4) A close-up of a young boy with short black hair and a concentrated expression. A hand enters from the side, pointing at the child's shirt. The setting is outdoors with a blurred background showing a white vehicle and a natural landscape.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) KID's voice is the primary signal, characterized by a medium pitch and high articulation clarity. He speaks with a professional yet energetic narrative tone, explaining the scoring system. The background is a very quiet room tone with no music. (2) An upbeat, fast-paced electronic BGM track enters the mix with a strong rhythmic beat. Sounds of water splashing and gurgling bubbles are audible as the diving montage plays. The audio events are dense and synchronized with the visual transitions. (3) The instructor's voice announces scores, punctuated by loud "ding" bell sound effects for each point. KID responds with high-arousal vocalizations, including shouting and laughter. A synthesized cheering crowd sound effect plays during the final celebratory announcement of his success. (4) The audio transitions to a playful interaction featuring a child's soft, high-pitched vocal. KID's voice becomes warm and gentle, asking the child questions. There is no BGM in this phase, creating a more intimate and natural acoustic atmosphere.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To showcase the journey and successful examination results of a celebrity (KID) aiming to become a divemaster, presented in an entertaining variety show format with emotional highs and a family-oriented conclusion.
